scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite research of thirteen context-engineering originals, preserving both original case variants. All 3464 original lines were read as inert data. No described agent, model, infrastructure, memory service, shell example, training procedure or research workflow was activated.
linked_reference_caveat: Only original bodies were read. Linked implementation files, papers, claims registry, protocol references, evaluation datasets and vendor documentation remain separate review prerequisites. Named studies, scores, model characteristics, cost multipliers, cache savings and theorem claims are source assertions, not independently established results or experimental outcomes here.

sources.workflow: Implement a real context-as-file harness with an immutable original prefix, bounded edit acceptance, explicit receipts, deterministic budget readouts and structurally legal rollback, then compare actual task success and prefix-reuse compute against matched baselines.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real released harness and parser, exact tokenizer and budget semantics, reviewed protocol and evidence references, actual public conversations and an independent invariant verifier are required. Model-trajectory and serving-cache claims additionally require authorized model access and compatible serving telemetry; the source itself says the diagnostic benchmark and multi-agent variant were not publicly released at retrieval.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual parser, role-folding, receipt, edit-gate or rollback defect can be tested offline using genuine released code and public message artifacts after review. Standard-library Python may support that narrow contract if real imports permit, not serving-cache relocation, RL or measured model accuracy. The editable-file sample was not run and no live context was modified.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact prefix bytes, non-escalation of model-written roles, round-trip-consistent token accounting, fit and shrink boundary behavior, no-op and failure receipts, output conditions for free turns and paired tool-result integrity across rollback. Independently validate success and compute with frozen tasks and matched backbones; shorter context, a synthetic counter or a source claim does not prove efficiency or safety against all persisted instructions.

sources.workflow: Build evidence-grounded direct or pairwise evaluation from a frozen rubric, perform deterministic input checks and position-swapped comparisons, map winners back to original candidate identities and calibrate judgments against independent labels.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real evaluation implementation, actual candidate outputs, exact criterion scales and weights, reviewed implementation and bias references and independently annotated comparison data are required. A genuine model judge needs separately authorized guarded provider access. Agreement confidence and claimed human correlation are not supplied by a JSON example.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual schema gate, rubric calculation, candidate-remapping or tie-aggregation bug can be offline using real public evaluation artifacts and stubbed judge responses. It is not a measured LLM judge, human preference experiment or production evaluation. Standard-library Python can support the deterministic portion only if the actual implementation fits.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify evidence fields before numeric output, legal score and confidence ranges, correct swapped-identity mapping, consistent-win aggregation and disagreement-to-tie behavior, including the example's potentially confusing second-pass labels. Independently check calibration, bias and agreement on held-out labels; position consistency alone is not probability calibration and model scores are not ground-truth outcomes.

sources.workflow: Track actual retrieved sources, validate relevance and evidence at phase boundaries, expose failures and unresolved contradictions and verify saved report contents before making bounded research-completeness claims.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual research question and source corpus, real retrieval-result and failure records, a grounded report and an independent citation and content verifier are required. Live browsing requires authorized network and source access. The named optimizer scores, iteration gains and detailed thinking expectations are source claims, not a released executable evaluator or permission to expose private reasoning.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual source-tracking, retrieved-versus-referenced distinction or report-validation task can be offline using genuine public retrieval artifacts and protocol stubs. It does not establish a fresh web search, universal completeness or reproduced optimizer performance. No source requests or unrelated session-history reads were made.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Match every factual citation to successfully retrieved content and its actual relevance, track failures without silently treating them as retrievals, preserve contradictions and verify persisted content rather than directory presence. Evaluate actual coverage against the fixed question and disclose unread evidence; no minimum paragraph length or generic confidence statement establishes research quality.

sources.workflow: Produce an anchored incremental handoff that preserves actual constraints, decisions, artifact identities, errors and next actions, then evaluate continuation and total task token use rather than summary length alone.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual public conversation and artifact histories, a reviewed implementation and evaluation reference, exact compression triggers and protected schema boundaries and independently grounded continuation probes are required. Real summarizer and token-efficiency measurement need separately authorized provider access and task-wide usage records. Published ratios are source-specific and linked papers remain unread.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected real incremental merge, identifier-preservation or artifact-index bug can be offline using genuine released code and public histories. A deterministic summary data check does not establish semantic preservation or real model continuation. No live context, schemas or history were compacted or deleted as part of this source review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify exact identifiers and constraints, correct merge of only newly truncated spans, truthful created versus modified versus read-only state, deduplication and retained original provenance. Use independent probes across all required dimensions and actual task completion with refetch and token records; lexical similarity, a compression ratio or one passing probe cannot establish preserved semantics or aggregate savings.

sources.workflow: Freeze outcome-oriented dimensions and representative cases, fail deterministic structural violations before any quality judgment, check actual end state and report per-dimension and per-stratum results against matched baselines.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real agent pipeline and public workload, independently specified end-state and rubric contracts, actual baseline records and reviewed metric references and implementations are required. Judge-based evaluation additionally needs calibrated labels and authorized guarded model access. Suggested case counts and alert thresholds are heuristics rather than a statistical guarantee.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual rubric arithmetic, manifest validation, duplicate-identity gate or result-aggregation code task can be offline on genuine public records. The illustrative scoring function is incomplete and does not provide an independently working evaluator. Standard-library Python may fit deterministic checking but not a full agent or production-monitoring experiment.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check actual structure and required evidence before scoring, exact normalized weights and legal score values, separate dimension-minimum failure from aggregate success and preserve stratum denominators and missing outcomes. Verify end-state behavior independently of agent narratives and report uncertainty and baseline comparability; favorable model judgment must not override invalid artifacts.

sources.workflow: Separate locked evaluators, narrow editable artifacts, append-only evidence and human-controlled actions, then checkpoint each actual hypothesis and evaluate, retain or reject it under fixed rules with recoverable failure records.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real harness and source artifact, immutable run-level metric and acceptance contract, exact edit allowlist, actual keep/discard/crash states and reviewed runbooks and rubric files are required. Broad autonomous source refresh or model search needs separate authorization and a genuine sandbox. A process description does not itself enforce filesystem or deployment permissions.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual state-machine, evaluator-lock, append-only log or checkpoint-recovery defect can be offline using real public artifacts and mocked external actions. It does not constitute a days-long autonomous run, implemented access control or permission to commit, push or merge. No loop or external action was launched.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Test known-good and known-bad artifacts under the unchanged evaluator, unauthorized writes and promotion attempts, crash and timeout handling, truthful rejected-attempt retention and exact rollback of only the allowed candidate changes. Verify novelty and pruning against actual registries and measured behavior; a self-reported monitor or altered scoring rule cannot establish acceptance.

sources.workflow: Implement an isolated session lifecycle with a known-image sandbox, controlled synchronization, durable snapshots and explicit result extraction, coordinating clients and bounded warm pools without conflating user identity, authorization and readiness.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real released service and infrastructure configuration, compatible isolated runtime and image assets, reviewed provider and framework references, exact session and authorization protocol and an independent isolation and lifecycle verifier are required. Actual hosted operation needs authorized sandbox resources and cost limits. Local code or a SQLite filename alone does not establish isolation.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual lifecycle, event-ordering, storage-key, snapshot-manifest or extraction bug can be offline using public implementation and stubbed infrastructure responses. It cannot prove a real cold-start time, remote provisioning, token refresh, concurrent resource isolation or created pull request. No shared Docker state, account, identity or infrastructure was changed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check cross-session state and authorization boundaries, exact revision consistency of read-derived decisions after synchronization, write gates, snapshot and extraction before teardown, token expiry and cancellation behavior and bounded cleanup. Independently measure real latency and load in an authorized sandbox; the source's unlimited-concurrency and safe-stale-read claims are not guarantees.

sources.workflow: Use actual voluntarily released and authorized observable agent records to identify repeated failure patterns, propose bounded prompt changes and evaluate real held-out behavior rather than accepting example optimizer scores.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual trace-capture and analyzer implementation and schema, reviewed linked documents, compatible dependencies and genuine public task and tool-result artifacts are required. Real capture, prompt optimization or skill generation may need authorized model access and specific provider-visible reasoning availability; private hidden reasoning must not be reconstructed or assumed accessible.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual public-trace parser, pattern classifier or artifact serializer can be offline after code and dependency review with external tools stubbed. The default runtime does not include the named optimizer, and fabricated thinking or score examples are not genuine model observations. No private session trace, system prompt or runtime hook was accessed or changed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Validate parsed observable events, exact source and task association, handling of missing trace fields, actual tool errors and preserved artifact provenance. Independently compare held-out outcomes and complete usage records under fixed tasks and budgets; increases from forty-five to eighty-five in an illustration or uncalibrated analyzer scores do not establish causal improvement.

sources.workflow: Write an exact grounded success predicate and explicit non-counting near misses, define independent audit conditions and evidence-based reporting, and keep actual permissions and budgets enforced outside the prompt.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real domain problem and deliverable, exact terms and degenerate cases, independent domain acceptance criteria and failure-mode checklist and reviewed dated claim references are required. Long-running model or parallel execution requires separately authorized sandbox resources and real budget controls. The source explicitly describes its mathematical exemplar as an unreviewed candidate proof without isolated prompt-element ablations.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual brief parser, constraint validator, approach-registry or evidence-ledger code task can be offline using genuine public artifacts. A well-formed brief is not a solved open problem or verified long-horizon outcome. The instruction to assume solvability does not supply proof or authorize hiding blocked cases, and no orchestration was launched.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check full quantified scope, exclusions and degeneracies, exact artifact evidence for each claimed success, independence from leaked answers and domain-level rejection of circular assumptions and narrowed results. Separately test enforced runtime limits and blocked-route reopening criteria. Agreement, effort floors, confident status reports or an answer-shaped artifact cannot substitute for goal-strength validation.

sources.workflow: Select the shallowest sufficient real persistence layer, store scoped provenance and temporal validity, retrieve only relevant actual evidence and consolidate without silently losing required history.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real public memory workload and actual implementation, exact entity and tenant identity and retention contracts, reviewed backend and consolidation references and independent retrieval labels are required. Semantic and graph systems need their compatible dependencies and pinned embedding space; cloud features or real model ingestion need separately authorized sandbox access. Framework rankings are not universal results.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual timestamp filter, entity-scoping, file-store or consolidation bug can be offline on genuine released public data and code after review. Local filesystem or SQLite behavior does not prove vector or temporal-graph quality. Example personal facts are not study inputs and no real user memory store or sensitive record was read or written.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check tenant isolation, exact validity-interval and ingestion-time semantics, conflicting facts and provenance, correct embedding-version boundaries, failure visibility and durable retry behavior. Evaluate current and historical queries against independent labels and retention requirements; newest timestamps alone do not prove truth, and a successful add or topically similar result is not correct retrieval.

sources.workflow: Choose a justified actual coordination topology, delegate independently scoped work with explicit state handoff, validate incoming artifacts and measure coordination overhead and outcomes against the matched single-agent baseline.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real orchestration implementation and decomposable public workload, reviewed framework references, exact handoff, cancellation, retry and state-ownership contracts and independent task success criteria are required. Real multi-model performance requires authorized guarded providers and full usage traces. Source cost multipliers, worker caps and claimed benchmark improvements are configuration-bound assertions.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual handoff router, message schema, idempotency, checkpoint or failure-propagation bug can be offline using genuine public code and stubbed agent messages. This tests deterministic orchestration only, not actual reasoning diversity, consensus accuracy or measured parallel speedup. No spawned-agent example in this source was executed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify exact destination and state preservation, bounded retries and cancellation, correct duplicate handling, isolated state, propagation of failed rather than success-shaped worker results and output validation at each boundary. Independently score real tasks and total cost and latency; weighted confidence, majority agreement or more role labels do not establish truth or useful diversity.

sources.workflow: Validate a representative actual task, implement discrete acquire, prepare, process, parse and render stages with durable provenance, reuse retained costly outputs and evaluate quality and complete cost before adding architecture complexity.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real grounded project and public representative input, actual source code and stage contracts, reviewed pipeline references, exact output acceptance and cache-validity rules and independent baselines are required. Real processing needs authorized guarded provider access and actual usage pricing records. Manual task fit and case-study costs are not supplied by the illustrative architecture.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual parser, cache manifest, stage invalidation or provenance defect can be offline on genuine retained public inputs and intermediate outputs. The default Python runtime may fit those deterministic stages, not an unreviewed provider stack. No paid processing stage was repeated and no actual output or downstream artifact was deleted.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify full artifact content and identity rather than file existence alone, exact upstream and downstream dependency invalidation, atomic persistence and recovery from partial files, explicit malformed-output failures and preservation of original evidence. Check actual schema semantics and task-wide usage independently; sensible defaults cannot turn missing required evidence into success, and rerunning a nondeterministic model is not idempotency.

sources.workflow: Implement a real tool or catalog contract with distinct routing purpose, exact parameter and output semantics, actionable failures and an evidence-based choice between consolidation and independently callable operations.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual released tool implementation and schemas, grounded caller workflows and observed public failure artifacts, exact provider-specific namespace registration and reviewed protocol and framework references are required. Agent behavior measurement additionally needs authorized guarded model access and held-out task labels. A descriptive name does not implement a tool or authorize its side effects.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual schema, dispatch, namespacing, concise-response or error-recovery code bug can be offline with genuine public artifacts and stubbed external services. It does not establish real agent selection improvement or live service behavior. The stated ServerName colon convention must be checked against the selected host rather than assumed universally required by MCP.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check actual registered names, collision handling, required types and bounds, truthful defaults and success/error shapes, exact side-effect scope, concise-mode preservation of required fields and safe actionable error content. Independently measure held-out routing and recovery before claiming improvements; fewer tools, a rewritten description or an example signature alone does not prove usability or correctness.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
